text:
Rina: Heads-up 1: GlacierCadence reported inconsistent tail latency during long context runs. Renewal meeting ~3w out. They pasted logs showing p95 spikes to ~7s on 12k-token evaluation. Want a low-risk ops plan we can run this week.
Dante: Can we do a targeted mitigation rather than full model swap? Maybe hybrid quant routing: keep hosted default for latency-sensitive flows, route large batch jobs to a quantized compact variant on dedicated infra.
Jo: Agree. Also propose dynamic split based on two axes: `prompt_tokens` and `customer_priority` tag. Example rule: if prompt_tokens > 2048 && customer_priority = high -> route to dedicated-compact-int8; else hosted-low-latency.
Rina: Important to reduce perceptible quality regressions. Any quick eval checklist?
Dante: Small eval plan:
1) 15 canonical prompts from GlacierCadence (mix of long-form and instruction).
2) Run model: baseline `gptx-3-8b` vs `gptx-3-8b-quant` (int8 + dynamic cast on attention).
3) Metrics: perplexity, stop-token drift, a manual spot-check on 5 outputs.
Will take ~50m.
Jo: I'll reserve a 4-GPU dedicated pool in us-west and add a canary route. ops-bot can we schedule a 3-hour canary with 10% traffic?
ops-bot: Canary job requested (id: canary-6954). ETA pool ready ~6m.
Rina: Also add fallback rules: if cohort error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 9s -> instant failover to hosted default. Also log sample responses to `cs-audit/glacier/` for the renewal deck.
Dante: One extra safety: run a short closed-loop AB on user-facing customers flagged `early_access=false` so we don't expose general users.
Jo: Done. Route rule: `if prompt_tokens > 2048 AND early_access=true -> dedicated-compact-int8-usw1`. Pushed config and will post link to monitor.
ops-bot: Dedicated pool provisioned. Canary live at 04:12 UTC. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/obs/glaciercadence/6954321000
Dante: Preliminary telemetry (first 30m): canary cohort p95 dropped from ~6.9s to ~2.2s. No spike in token-level diffs on spot-checks.
Rina: Nice. Jo, keep fallback enabled and keep canary at 10% for 3h, then escalate to 40% for 24h if stable. I'll coordinate a check-in with the CSM tomorrow and attach the eval artifacts to the renewal notes.
Jo: I'll capture the log bundle and add the checklist to the CS playbook. ops-bot will post status updates.
ops-bot: Canary threshold checks running every 5m. Will alert channel on breach.
Rina: Thanks team. This should buy us breathing room before renewal. We'll recommend a staged permanent route change if 24h stability holds.
